title: AI impact assessment, OMB M-25-21 Section 4(b)(ii) (items A-G)
description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii), p. 16: "Agencies must complete an AI impact assessment before deploying any high-impact AI use case. These assessments must be updated periodically and throughout the AI's lifecycle, as appropriate, using target variables that anticipate real-world outcomes. The AI impact assessments must be documented and address or include, at a minimum:" Structure only: filling this form does not show compliance with M-25-21.

high_impact_status.title: High-impact status
enum: Presumed high-impact, but determined not high impact

A.title: A. Intended purpose and expected benefit
A.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(A), p. 16: "the intended purpose for the AI and its expected benefit, supported by specific metrics or qualitative analysis, assessing impact inclusive of but not limited to costs, customer experience, or expected positive outcomes of AI use, as compared to existing agency processes;"
A.x-memo-quote: the intended purpose for the AI and its expected benefit, supported by specific metrics or qualitative analysis, assessing impact inclusive of but not limited to costs, customer experience, or expected positive outcomes of AI use, as compared to existing agency processes;

B.title: B. Quality and appropriateness of data and model capability
B.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(B), p. 16: "the quality and appropriateness of the relevant data and model capability, supported by a summary of the data used in the AI's design, development, training, testing, and operation and its fitness for the AI's intended purpose; describe the data collection, and preparation process; and indicate whether the data is to be publicly disclosed as an open government data asset. When applicable, this summary must describe information included in the data about classes protected by Federal nondiscrimination laws;"
B.x-memo-quote: the quality and appropriateness of the relevant data and model capability, supported by a summary of the data used in the AI's design, development, training, testing, and operation and its fitness for the AI's intended purpose; describe the data collection, and preparation process; and indicate whether the data is to be publicly disclosed as an open government data asset. When applicable, this summary must describe information included in the data about classes protected by Federal nondiscrimination laws;

C.title: C. Potential impacts of using AI
C.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(C), p. 16: "the potential impacts of using AI, supported by documentation on potential impacts on the privacy, civil rights, and civil liberties of the public, and of using or not using AI. The assessment should reference privacy impact assessments, CAIO-approved minimum risk management practice waivers or other materials, if relevant, and also describe any planned mitigation measures for anticipated negative impacts, such as unlawful discrimination;"
C.x-memo-quote: the potential impacts of using AI, supported by documentation on potential impacts on the privacy, civil rights, and civil liberties of the public, and of using or not using AI. The assessment should reference privacy impact assessments, CAIO-approved minimum risk management practice waivers or other materials, if relevant, and also describe any planned mitigation measures for anticipated negative impacts, such as unlawful discrimination;

D.title: D. Reassessment scheduling and procedures
D.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(D), p. 16: "reassessment scheduling and procedures, supported by schedules for periodic reassessments as well as reassessment requirements following significant modifications to an underlying AI system, in addition to the specific requirements and processes for such testing;"
D.x-memo-quote: reassessment scheduling and procedures, supported by schedules for periodic reassessments as well as reassessment requirements following significant modifications to an underlying AI system, in addition to the specific requirements and processes for such testing;

E.title: E. Related costs analysis
E.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(E), p. 16: "related costs analysis, supported by a summary of direct costs associated and expected savings, if any;"
E.x-memo-quote: related costs analysis, supported by a summary of direct costs associated and expected savings, if any;

F.title: F. Results of independent review
F.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(F), p. 16: "results of independent review, supported by an independent reviewer within the agency who has not been involved in the development. The independent reviewer of the impact assessment shall identify any potential concerns or gaps. Any comments provided by the independent reviewer must be included in the impact assessment documentation and shared with the individual accepting the risk for the AI use case when that determination is made; and"
F.x-memo-quote: results of independent review, supported by an independent reviewer within the agency who has not been involved in the development. The independent reviewer of the impact assessment shall identify any potential concerns or gaps. Any comments provided by the independent reviewer must be included in the impact assessment documentation and shared with the individual accepting the risk for the AI use case when that determination is made; and

G.title: G. Risk acceptance
G.description: OMB M-25-21, Appendix, Section 4(b)(ii)(G), p. 17: "risk acceptance, supported by a signature from the individual accepting the risk."
G.x-memo-quote: risk acceptance, supported by a signature from the individual accepting the risk.
